heading: Short title and commencement.
text:
(1) This Act may be called the Air Force Act, 1950.

(2) It shall come into force on such date[1] as the Central Government may by notification in the Official Gazette, appoint in this behalf.
notes: 22nd July, 1950, vide Notification No. S.R.O. 124, dated 22nd July, see Gazette of India, 1950, Part II, sec. 4.
